reviews.x: My hair is long, fine and straight.  The smooth clips simply slide out, which is a real pain when trying to hold sections of hair while I touch up my roots or style my hair.  These clips are marvelous. Sections of hair stay in place while I do what I intended to do.  They are about 4" to 5" long, similar in length to the other smooth straight ones. With 10 in a pack, I'll be having these for a long time.

Really good quality clips! They feel salon-grade! These work well on thick hair. That being said, these are a little stiffer so you may want to break them in a little while before you start clipping your hair, especially if your hair is prone to breakage with hair ties. Also I want to specify that I keep them in the packaging and keep them on the cardboard strip they're clipped on, since they don't come with a carrying case.

These are good, as they are fairly unobtrusive when worn. The rubber coating prevents painful snags and hair strands being broken, which is definitely good. I thought, though, they would hold more hair. I'm happy with them but may also need another type or brand of jaw clip.

The other clips I had pulled my hair so when I saw all the positive reviews for these,I decided to purchase them,  They are super-gentle on my hair and don't pull at all. I use them mainly for sectioning off my hair when I use my Revlon Volumizing Dryer.  I have babt-fine hair and they hold very well. They would also work great for extra-thick hair.  I'm Very happy with this purchase and would order again.

These are basic hair clips---to a degree.  Yet, not basic because they are rubber coated.  They hold my hair for styling and do not "rip" my hair out as do other clips.  They are comfortable and work great.  I am sooo glad I bought these over others I had looked at.  Very happy customer!

They're pretty sturdy, but they snag my hair every single time I use them. I feel like the rubber should have been only on the handle and the bumps on the inside of the clip needed to be smoother. I have to be really careful not to break my hair when using them.

reviews.t: They are nice and strudy but they snag like crazy
reviews.x: They are nice and strudy but they snag like crazy!  I think its the matte finish... idk but i like the regular ones (shiny) better
Great product, packaged well, and as described. Can be used on all hair types, no snags. I will definitely purchase again!!

reviews.t: Perfect replacement for crummy drugstore brand clips.
reviews.x: I purchased these to replace my drugstore brand clips that are constantly breaking. I have thick, short hair that I pin by the layer for styling each day, and it usually slips. When I received these, I was a little wary of how slim they are, but I shouldn't have been. They're very sturdy. The almost-rubbery, matte finish makes them inherently slip free, and they hold every strand of my thick hair in place until I'm ready to move to the next layer. And they're a steal compared to the drugstore br

reviews.t: This is great for first timers DIY hair dye
reviews.x: I was concern of how I was going to hold my thick voluminous hair up when trying to dye it for the first time. These are truly non-slip. I was so happy to see that they held well for hours. Way cheaper than buying locally. Great quality.

I use these to portion out my hair to apply slippery hair products, and even when my hair and hands are covered in goo, these don't slip out of my hair or my hands. I can't recommend these highly enough!

reviews.t: Works perfect on my medium length hair
reviews.x: Works perfect on my medium, fine length hair.  Use them to hold my hair away from my face and to hold curlers in place.  Unlike other clips I have tried, these do not snag or pull my hair.
Love my clips! They didn't take a long time to get here and I appreciate that. They also have a strong hold on the hair. I made a good choice purchasing these
It hurts to take these out of my hair, but they hold extremely well!

I had been seeing similar clips around but I'm glad I found these here. I got triple the clips for what I would pay at a beauty supply. I thought there would be visible rubber pieces but there isn't. However, it doesn't take away from the effectiveness at all. These really are easy to use when your hands are wet. Also, grips hair well; even when slick with conditioner. As a natural, it works well at keeping my roots stretched for wash and go styles. Definitely would recommend it.

I am completely satisfied with these clips.  They hold a lot of my daughter's thick curly hair as I section it.  Her hair does not slip out nor does it stick or get snagged.  Since my hands are wet with water and conditioner I was looking for clips that would be easy to hold and open.  The handles are a good size, the clips open easily, and my wet hands don't slip off as I squeeze to open.

So I have a very thick hair and I have trouble with clip sliding out or just hurting because they're pulling out when I'm trying to hold my hair up because they can't hold the weight of it. I use these clips to help me when I'm styling my hair the rubber on them helps them stay in place perfectly great product I have no issues.

reviews.t: Durable, non-slip, holds ton of hair
reviews.x: I can't even express my love for these clips. They've changed my life. As a cosmetologist with buttery hands, I drop clips left and right to the point I don't have anymore. These babies have never slid out of my hand. They hold a TON of hair, I've used them on every hair texture and density with no problems at all.

reviews.t: Mosher Salon Rubber Coated No-Slip Grip
reviews.x: Glad I spent the money on these clips I have very thick hair and other clips break or will not hold.  My hair is long and very thick and these work great. They do not slip, hold in place and hold a lot of hair in place. Love them well worth the money I spent on them as I believe they will last.

I use these on the shower mainly to section my hair bc it's so thick. These things really stay in place and won't break on my like others. I enjoy that they have the grippy pads at the end and are fully coated in the rubber. There is not slippage and does not pull on my 3b/3c curls

These clips are great! Easy to handle, durable, and easy to place in the hair as needed. The clips give a firm grip of the hair, holds very well. Best clips I've ever used. I highly recommend these clips. Package and delivery was very good, timely and undamaged.

reviews.t: it can actually hold my hair. i have very thick hair

reviews.t: I am so very pleased with these rubber hair clips
reviews.x: I am so very pleased with these rubber hair clips.  Compared to the ones that I've had in the past, these are sturdy and very strong.  They are exactly what I need to hold my thick hair when I section to apply hair products.  Thank you so very much!!! 🙂🙂🙂

reviews.t: wavy hair and like to use clips to add volume to my crown ...
reviews.x: I have thick, wavy hair and like to use clips to add volume to my crown and make curls.  These are a significant improvement from other clips I have used as they do not catch, snag or pull my hair.  I will most likely be purchasing more.  Thanks!

Love them. Came just in time and I'm amazed it can hold my hair when I'm styling it. Usually clips break or my hair comes out of it because how straight my hair is but these clips are amazing! Definitely worth paying for

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the strong, non-slip hold that keeps hair sections in place, even on thick or slippery hair.
Many customers say the clips are gentle and do not pull, snag, or break their hair, especially on fine or thinning hair.
Several reviewers describe the clips as sturdy and salon-grade quality.
A notable minority report that the clips snag or pull their hair despite the rubber coating.
Some customers note the clips are stiffer or hold less hair than expected.
